query:
SELECT 
  c.order_index,
  c.section_type,
  LEFT(c.content, 60) as content_preview
FROM content c
JOIN pages p ON c.page_id = p.id
JOIN jobs j ON p.job_id = j.id
WHERE j.id = 90007
ORDER BY c.order_index
LIMIT 20
